task_id.description: ID of the running background task to watch. Pass this or command

command.description: Shell command to start and watch; it stops when the monitor ends. Pass this or task_id

run_outside_sandbox.description: With command: ask the user to run it outside the OS sandbox. Only after the sandbox refused it, or when you know it cannot work in the sandbox

pattern.description: Regular expression (RE2 syntax) matched against each output line

persistent.description: Keep watching after a match and report every later one. Default false: the first match ends the monitor

timeout.description: How long to watch, in milliseconds. Default 3600000 (one hour), at most 86400000

description.description: A short label of what this call works on or looks for, shown to the user as its row: a noun phrase of 2 to 6 words, no leading verb
